name: @aliceo2/infologger
description: Infologger GUI to query and stream log events
author: Vladimir Kosmala

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run mocha
scripts.coverage: nyc npm test && npm run coverage:report
scripts.docker:dev:local-live: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.dev.yaml --profile local-ilg up --build
scripts.docker:dev:local-query: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.dev.yaml --profile local-db up --build
scripts.docker:dev:local-both: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.dev.yaml --profile local-db --profile local-ilg up --build
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.test.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from application
scripts.docker:cleanup: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.dev.yaml -f docker-compose.test.yaml --profile '*' down -v --remove-orphans
